items.content_text: >modern CISC (Complex Instruction Set Computer) chips like x86 internally translate complex instructions into streamlined, RISC-like micro-operations, eliminating the historical power penalty of the instruction set Every Intel or AMD processor bullt today is a RISC engine at its core.
